svg.aria-label: A light's route through the engine: importLight turns each UsdLux light type into a scene::Light on a node, and every frame, in the demo's Record, Scene::CollectLights resolves each against its node's world matrix into LightItems plus the ambient, which SceneRenderer::WriteLights writes into this frame's light buffer. Mesh.frag.glsl loops over the lights, and Composite.frag.glsl applies exposure and the tone curve and encodes.
